identity.title: ALMA and Herschel reveal that X-ray-selected AGN and main-sequence galaxies have different star formation rate distributions
identity.journal: Monthly Notices of the Royal Astronomical Society

paper_type_evidence.quote: Using deep *Herschel* and ALMA observations, we investigate the star formation rate (SFR) distributions of X-ray selected AGN host galaxies

targets.name: X-ray AGN in 4 Ms CDF-S (high-z, 24 ALMA targets)

evidence.quote: The high-*z* sample were all selected from the 4 Ms *Chandra* Deep Field South (hereafter, CDF-S) survey catalogue described in (cite: Xue11) with updated redshifts from (cite: Hsu14)

question.value: Do X-ray selected AGN hosts have the same SFR distribution relative to the main sequence as normal star-forming galaxies?

evidence.quote: we test this by combining deep *Herschel* and ALMA observations to instead constrain the *distribution* of host galaxy SFRs of a sample of X-ray selected AGNs

validation.value: Conclusions unchanged with Chary01 or Arp220 SEDs; ALMA and Herschel SFRs consistent for four sources detected by both

evidence.quote: our conclusions do not change if we instead use either the (cite: Chary01) SEDs or a starburst SED (i.e., Arp220)

claims.hypothesis: X-ray AGN hosts follow the MS R_MS distribution
claims.experiment: Compare R_MS fractions and fitted log-normals of ALMA+Herschel AGN sample to MS galaxies
claims.result: AGN distribution about twice as broad and peaks ~0.4 dex lower
claims.finding: AGN and MS SFR distributions differ significantly

evidence.loc: 4.2 Parameterising an X-ray AGN SFR distribution
evidence.quote: which we find is roughly twice as broad as, and peaks $\approx0.4$ dex below, that of MS galaxies

claims.hypothesis: Stacking results (AGN SFR consistent with MS) conflict with the distribution result
claims.experiment: Compute linear mean of fitted log-normals
claims.finding: Linear mean is biased by bright outliers and not a reliable typical SFR

evidence.quote: these linear-means are, indeed, influenced by the high tail of the broad $R_{\rm MS}$ distribution

why_this_method.value: Small samples and many non-detections prevent direct determination of the distribution, so a log-normal form is assumed for comparison

evidence.loc: 4.2 Parameterising an X-ray AGN SFR distribution
evidence.quote: Our relatively small sample sizes, combined with the large fraction of non-detections prevents us from determining the AGN $R_{\rm MS}$ distribution directly.

limitations_admitted.value: Log-normal is not a literal description of the true AGN distribution

evidence.loc: 4.2 Parameterising an X-ray AGN SFR distribution
evidence.quote: is not to be taken as a literal description of the true AGN $R_{\rm MS}$ distribution

referee_caveats_inferred: Single-template SED assumption with ±0.3 dex uncertainty; no full SED fitting
Results depend on assumed log-normal form
Only 7/24 ALMA detections, so heavily upper-limit driven
Possible AGN contribution to sub-mm not discussed
